thread:
Iris: Quick thread: we need a small, enforceable checklist for terminology edits so PRs are mergeable without long back-and-forth. Goal: reduce friction during the large style pass.

Marco: I propose a 4-item checklist that must be satisfied before merging: 1) canonical term used for user-facing text ("model"), 2) code examples use exact API param names, 3) JSON examples use lower_snake_case unless demonstrating SDK code, 4) add changelog line to modified pages.

Janelle: +1. Add one more: include a one-line rationale in the PR description when deviating from the rules (e.g., legacy CLI compatibility). That keeps reviewers informed.

Iris: Good call. Let's formalize the checklist and add it to style-guide.md and the PR template. Also add a short example snippet for reviewers: "If you see `modelName`, change to `model` in examples and leave a migration note."

Marco: I'll update .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with the checklist items and a link to the style guide section.

Janelle: I'll run a grep pass for `modelName|--model-name|model-name|checkpoint` and post a CSV to DOCS-4933 with page owners. We should prioritize pages with high traffic first.

docs-bot: Reminder: apply labels `#docs` and `#terminology` to all style pass PRs. If a PR touches >15 pages, request a team lead review.

Iris: Thanks. After the checklist is live, we'll let the bulk fixes roll through and monitor for any user confusion on the changelog entries.
